item.title: Google Earnings: AI Search Is Changing Travel Discovery, Even Before Booking Tools Arrive
item.description: Google’s AI search is changing how travelers find trips. The booking tools aren’t here yet, but the traffic dynamics are already shifting — and the rules for capturing demand are shifting with them.

item.title: IndiGo Cuts Europe Flights as Airspace Disruptions Ripple Across Indian Aviation
item.description: With key westbound air corridors effectively closed, more route cuts and thinner schedules are likely.

item.title: Marriott Lines Up Another India Brand Launch: What we Got from Ventive Hospitality’s Filing
item.description: Marriott possibly adding a new brand to its India mix points to it using a "something for everybody" approach – allowing it to tap into all segments and act as a one-stop shop for all accommodation needs.

item.title: Dusit Hotels Charts European Push as It Looks to Export Thai Hospitality Beyond Asia
item.description: Competing for attention in Europe, one of the world’s most crowded hotel markets, Dusit’s size could work in its favor. However, the challenge would be to translate Thai hospitality into a European context without over-explaining it or softening it.

item.title: Scaling Up African Tourism: Fixing Execution, Hotel Supply, and Investment
item.description: Africa’s tourism growth challenge isn’t demand — it’s execution: scaling reliable operations, mid-market infrastructure, and globally exportable talent to turn world-class assets into sustainable volume growth.

item.title: Olympics to Require Climate Measures From All Future Hosts
item.description: The IOC is warning that global warming could impact the Winter Olympics while simultaneously standing by fossil-fuel sponsorships.

item.title: Accor’s Message to Sofitel Owners: ‘Renovate, Rebrand, or Exit’
item.description: Accor, the Paris-based hospitality company, is continuing a sweeping renovation campaign at Sofitel, its largest luxury hotel brand.

item.title: American Airlines Unions Escalate Pressure on CEO After Storm Failures and Weak Profits
item.description: American’s weak earnings means less profit-sharing for employees — and unions are losing patience.

item.title: The 2026 Winter Olympics Are an Endurance Test for Travelers, Not Just Athletes
item.description: Milano Cortina 2026 is testing whether modern mega-events can function without a single dominant transport hub.
